excerpts.section: Group policy: Legal > SECTION 6  Data retention
excerpts.text:
Call recordings are retained for the purpose of settling complaints and resolving disputes, and the retention rules are set out in the data protection schedule. Call recordings are kept for 1 years and then deleted. The schedule is reviewed by the legal team each time the processing purpose changes, and any change is communicated to the team leaders before it takes effect.

Access to recordings is limited to the legal team and to the quality team, and each access is logged with the reason. A recording that is needed beyond the normal period, for example for an open dispute, is marked for extended retention with the case reference. The legal team confirms the end of the extension, and the recording is then deleted in the normal way. The confirmation is recorded in the case file together with the date of deletion.

Customer records held under this procedure are retained according to the schedule approved by the legal team, and the schedule sets out what must be kept and what must be removed. Signed customer contracts are kept for 15 years and then deleted. Call recordings and case notes follow their own shorter schedule, which is set out in the same table. The customer care system deletes records automatically when the retention period ends, but any record linked to an open dispute is held until the dispute closes. Staff must not keep copies of customer documents on personal devices, and any such copy found during an audit is removed and reported. Staff who need to work away from the office use the secure portal only, and printed customer documents are shredded at the end of the call.

Το Νομικό Τμήμα ζητά να αποτυπωθεί στην παρούσα ενότητα η πολιτική διατήρησης των δεδομένων που παράγονται στις επικοινωνίες με τους πελάτες. Οι ηχογραφήσεις κλήσεων, οι σημειώσεις των συμβούλων στο Atlas και το ιστορικό των αιτημάτων στο Relay αποτελούν προσωπικά δεδομένα και διατηρούνται μόνο για όσο χρονικό διάστημα απαιτείται για τον σκοπό της επεξεργασίας. Η περίοδος διατήρησης κάθε κατηγορίας καθορίζεται στον πίνακα της υπηρεσίας προστασίας δεδομένων και δεν αλλάζει χωρίς γραπτή έγκριση. Η πρόσβαση σε αρχεία που έχουν ξεπεράσει την περίοδό τους περιορίζεται σε όσους έχουν ρητή εντολή του Νομικού Τμήματος. Οι σύμβουλοι δεν αντιγράφουν ηχογραφήσεις σε προσωπικούς φακέλους ούτε τις στέλνουν με ηλεκτρονικό ταχυδρομείο, και κάθε εξαίρεση καταγράφεται ως συμβάν ασφαλείας.

Η διαγραφή γίνεται με κεντρική διαδικασία που αφήνει ίχνος στο αρχείο ελέγχου, ώστε να αποδεικνύεται ότι τα δεδομένα αφαιρέθηκαν στον προβλεπόμενο χρόνο. Κάθε ζήτημα που δεν καλύπτεται από την πολιτική αυτή παραπέμπεται στο Νομικό Τμήμα πριν από οποιαδήποτε ενέργεια, και η απάντηση προς τον πελάτη περιμένει την έγκριση.

Customer care records contain personal details that the company must protect, and the playbook sets out how long each type of record is kept. The legal team maintains the retention table, and the table states the purpose of each record type so that agents know why a record should not be deleted early. Recordings of calls and notes on accounts are handled separately, because they are often needed in a later complaint. When a customer asks for their data to be removed, the request is passed to the legal team, who decide which records must be kept for legal reasons and which can be removed. Agents do not copy customer details into personal notes or messaging applications. Any access to a record outside the normal workflow is logged and reviewed.

excerpts.text:
Οι ηχογραφήσεις των τηλεφωνικών συνομιλιών και τα αρχεία συγκατάθεσης αποτελούν ειδική κατηγορία, γιατί φυλάσσονται για να αποδεικνύεται τι συμφωνήθηκε και όχι για να βελτιώνεται η εξυπηρέτηση. Το πρότυπο διατήρησης καθορίζει για κάθε κατηγορία την περίοδο φύλαξης και τον λόγο της, και το νομικό τμήμα επικαιροποιεί τον πίνακα όταν αλλάζει το πλαίσιο. Η πρόσβαση στις ηχογραφήσεις επιτρέπεται μόνο σε πρόσωπα που χρειάζονται το αρχείο για συγκεκριμένη υπόθεση, και κάθε άνοιγμα καταγράφεται με την αιτία. Η συγκατάθεση του πελάτη καταγράφεται με την ημερομηνία και το κανάλι όπου δόθηκε, και ο φάκελος της συγκατάθεσης συνδέεται με τη σύμβαση. Όταν ο πελάτης ανακαλεί τη συγκατάθεσή του, το τμήμα ενημερώνει τα συστήματα που εξαρτώνται από αυτήν και καταγράφει την ενέργεια.

Ο πελάτης λαμβάνει γραπτή επιβεβαίωση της ενέργειας, που κλείνει τον φάκελο.

excerpts.section: Group policy: Legal > SECTION 5  Data retention
excerpts.text:
Personal data is retained only for as long as it is needed for the purpose for which it was collected, and this policy sets the principle that applies to every system. Each category of data has a retention period recorded in the retention schedule, and the schedule is approved by the legal team and the data protection officer. Records of contracts, billing and customer correspondence are kept for the period required by the law, and then they are deleted or anonymised. Retention periods must be applied by the system wherever possible, rather than by a manual clean up that depends on memory. Backups follow the same retention rules, and a restored backup must not reintroduce data that has already been deleted. The legal team reviews the schedule when a new product is launched or when the law changes. Requests to change the retention period for a category must be justified in writing and approved before they are applied.

Staff who find personal data kept beyond its period must report it to the data protection officer at once.

ec0d6725ffa54b6e108951fc97a40699.text:
A legal hold suspends the normal deletion of data when a dispute, an investigation or a legal claim is foreseeable. The legal team issues the hold in writing, identifies the categories and systems affected, and records the date on which the hold begins. While a hold is in place, the owners of the affected systems must not delete or alter the relevant records, even if the normal period has passed. The hold register lists every active hold, its scope and the person responsible for it, and it is reviewed at the close of each period. Once the matter is closed, the legal team lifts the hold in writing, and the deletion schedule resumes for the affected records. Deletion of data that is not under hold is carried out through the approved process, which keeps a log of what was removed and when. Requests from data subjects to delete their data are handled within the legal framework, and the legal team checks whether any hold or other obligation prevents deletion.

Staff must not use a hold as a reason to keep data that has no other purpose.

excerpts.text:
Η διάρκεια των συμβολαίων είναι η ερώτηση που εμφανίζεται πιο συχνά στις επικοινωνίες με τους πελάτες. Τα συμβόλαια για την κατηγορία «συμβόλαια κινητής» έχουν ελάχιστη διάρκεια 12 μηνών. Ο σύμβουλος εξηγεί τη διάρκεια πριν από την υπογραφή, μαζί με τις χρεώσεις που ισχύουν σε περίπτωση πρόωρης αποχώρησης, και καταγράφει στο Atlas ότι ο πελάτης ενημερώθηκε. Η διάρκεια δεν αλλάζει χωρίς νέο συμβόλαιο, ακόμη και όταν ο πελάτης ζητά μεταφορά σε άλλο πρόγραμμα. Οι συμβάσεις άλλων κατηγοριών έχουν διαφορετικούς όρους, και ο σύμβουλος δεν πρέπει να τους εφαρμόζει από μνήμης. Όταν ο πελάτης ρωτά για την ακριβή ημερομηνία λήξης, ο σύμβουλος τη βρίσκει στο Atlas και δεν την υπολογίζει χειροκίνητα, ώστε να μη υπάρχει διαφορά με το σύστημα.

Οι συμβάσεις που ανανεώνονται αυτόματα ελέγχονται ξανά πριν από την ανανέωση, γιατί ο πελάτης έχει δικαίωμα να ενημερωθεί για την αλλαγή των όρων. Η διάρκεια της σύμβασης αναγράφεται και στην απόδειξη παραλαβής, ώστε ο πελάτης να μπορεί να τη συγκρίνει με την υπογραφή του. Όταν ο πελάτης ζητά πρόωρη λύση, ο σύμβουλος ενημερώνει τον υπεύθυνο, που εξετάζει τις επιλογές γραπτά.

5781b31b749345c68177f9bbfaf29f66.section: Group policy: Returns > SECTION 3  Return authorisation
5781b31b749345c68177f9bbfaf29f66.text: Return authorisation is the formal permission to send a product back, and it is issued through the returns system once the eligibility has been confirmed. No product may be posted back without an authorisation number, and the courier will refuse a parcel that does not carry one. Authorisation numbers are single use, so that the same number cannot support separate returns. The agent records the reason for return in the system and selects the correct code, because the code drives the inspection route. Customers are told how to attach the number to the parcel and how long the return process usually takes. An authorisation can be cancelled if the customer changes their mind before the product is dispatched, and the cancellation is recorded in the case.

7e068022a166776fbc255be83dfc4a01.text: Η διάρκεια των συμβολαίων είναι η ερώτηση που εμφανίζεται πιο συχνά στις επικοινωνίες με τους πελάτες. Internal support for the sales organisation is available through the Relay queue, and each request must name the team, the store and the product or system involved. Gifts from suppliers or customers must be declared to the line manager and are not accepted if they could influence a sale. 5781b31b749345c68177f9bbfaf29f66.section: Group policy: Returns > SECTION 3  Return authorisation
5781b31b749345c68177f9bbfaf29f66.text: Return authorisation is the formal permission to send a product back, and it is issued through the returns system once the eligibility has been confirmed. No product may be posted back without an authorisation number, and the courier will refuse a parcel that does not carry one. Authorisation numbers are single use, so that the same number cannot support separate returns. The agent records the reason for return in the system and selects the correct code, because the code drives the inspection route. Customers are told how to attach the number to the parcel and how long the return process usually takes. An authorisation can be cancelled if the customer changes their mind before the product is dispatched, and the cancellation is recorded in the case.

The customer receives a prepaid label and packing guidance, and the agent confirms the address and the contact number before the label is issued. If the customer cannot pack the device, the agent arranges collection through the approved courier, and the collection time is confirmed to the customer in writing. Accessories are not sent unless they are needed to diagnose the fault, and the agent notes which accessories were included in the parcel. The customer is told that the repair centre may contact them directly about the fault, and that all communication about the repair is then recorded in the case file.

7b05005f979352ca4f5a5e5600bac3db.text: Return authorisation confirms that a customer may send a product back and that the return is valid under the policy. The returns agent checks the purchase record and the return history before issuing the authorisation, so that repeated returns are spotted early. A customer may make at most 3 returns in any twelve months without a supervisor's review. Returns above that level are referred to the supervisor, who checks whether the pattern reflects a genuine fault, a service issue or misuse. The supervisor records the decision in the case, with the reason, so that the customer can be told the outcome accurately. Authorisation numbers are issued only after the review is complete, and the agent does not send a return label before the number is confirmed. Customers should be told the process at the start of the call so that they know what to expect.

excerpts.section: Group policy: Customer Care > SECTION 5  Callbacks and holding, part 2
excerpts.text: Holding is a service that the customer experiences directly, so the policy sets a clear limit on how long a customer can be kept in the queue before the team offers a change. Callers should not be kept on hold for more than 8 minutes. When the limit is reached, the agent offers a callback or a transfer to a different queue with a shorter expected wait, and records the choice that the customer made. Hold music must be neutral and free of marketing messages, and its volume must be checked by the team leader during the shift. Each team keeps a short log of holding times, so that the average wait can be compared between queues and the best practice shared. Customers who are told how long they may wait are less likely to hang up before the call is answered.

excerpts.section: Procedure: Customer Care > SECTION 7  Callbacks and holding, part 2
excerpts.text: Callbacks are a promise, and the procedure requires agents to keep every promise that they make during a call. A promised callback must happen within 90 minutes. If the agent who made the promise is unavailable, the case passes to a colleague with the full note, and the colleague confirms the time with the customer. Agents do not promise a callback in a different window to make the queue look shorter, and any callback that is missed is reported to the team leader with its reason. A callback that is completed is recorded with the outcome, even when the customer does not answer, so that the attempt is visible to the next agent. Agents who make a promise they cannot keep must say so at once, rather than leave the promise to be missed quietly.

excerpts.section: Procedure: Customer Care > SECTION 2  Callbacks and holding
excerpts.text: When a customer must wait, the agent explains the reason for the wait and offers a callback if the wait is expected to be long. A callback is booked in the system with the best number and the agreed time window. The agent confirms the booking to the customer before ending the call, and reads the time back to them. If the agent places the customer on hold, the agent returns to the line at the time stated, or sends a message through the channel the customer prefers. Calls are never disconnected while the customer is still waiting for an answer. Where a callback cannot be completed, the agent records the reason and reschedules it within the same working day.

Conduct rules apply to every person who speaks to a customer, whether in a shop, on the phone or in writing, and they are the same for all sales channels. Advisors confirm the identity of the customer before discussing any account, and they never share details with a third party without written authority recorded in Atlas. Pressure selling, misleading comparisons and promises the company cannot keep are not acceptable under any sales target. Advisors who are unsure about a claim say so, and then check the approved product sheet before answering. Gifts from suppliers or customers must be declared to the line manager and are not accepted if they could influence a sale. Complaints about an advisor's conduct are reported to the team leader and recorded without delay. Managers review a sample of recorded calls and written exchanges at the end of each period to check the standard. Anyone who finds that a colleague has broken these rules must report it, and the report is handled confidentially.

excerpts.section: Group policy: Customer Care > SECTION 2  Callbacks and holding
excerpts.text: Every callback must be recorded in the case system with the customer's name, the number to call and the reason for the call. A callback booked for a particular time must be made at that time or updated in advance with the customer's agreement. Holding is permitted only for the time needed to complete a specific check, and the customer must be told why they are being held. Customers must not be left in a holding queue without a message, because silence increases complaints and damages trust. Where the holding time exceeds what was said, the agent returns to the line, apologises and explains the current position. Callbacks that cannot be completed are passed to the team leader for reassignment, and no callback may be closed without the outcome recorded.

Customer contact is conducted with respect, accuracy and confidentiality at all times. Staff verify the identity of the caller before discussing any account, and they never reveal account details to a third party without a valid authority on file. Recording of calls is disclosed at the start of each call, and the recording is used only for quality, training and dispute purposes. Staff must not pressure customers into decisions, and they must not describe a product in a way that is misleading. Notes on the case must be factual, polite and free of personal opinions, because the customer may request a copy of the record. Any suspected breach of these rules is reported to the team leader immediately, so that the risk can be contained.

excerpts.section: FAQ and case notes: Customer Care > SECTION 2  Callbacks and holding
excerpts.text:
Customers often ask whether they can be called back instead of waiting, and the answer is yes when the queue is long. The handler offers the option, records a preferred time window and confirms the number to be used before ending the call. A callback should be made by the same handler wherever possible, because a new person asking the same questions is one of the main reasons customers complain. If the call cannot be returned, the note goes back into the queue with the reason. Customers who have already solved the problem through another route should be asked whether the callback is still needed, so that they are not called for nothing. Handlers never promise a callback time that they cannot keep, and they record any missed callback so that the pattern can be reviewed.

Η ρήτρα διαγραφής οφειλών αφορά τις μικρές απαιτήσεις που κρίνονται ανεπίδεκτες είσπραξης μετά από εύλογη προσπάθεια. Από την 1 Ιουλίου 2025, οφειλές κάτω των 18 ευρώ μπορούν να διαγραφούν μετά από δώδεκα μήνες. Η διαγραφή δεν γίνεται αυτόματα από το σύστημα, αλλά προτείνεται από την ομάδα είσπραξης και εγκρίνεται από τον υπεύθυνο οικονομικών, ο οποίος ελέγχει ότι δεν υπάρχει εκκρεμής αίτηση του πελάτη ή ρύθμιση δόσεων. Η ομάδα είσπραξης καταγράφει τον λόγο της πρότασης, ώστε ο έλεγχος να βλέπει αν η απόφαση στηρίχθηκε σε στοιχεία και όχι σε πίεση χρόνου.

Η ρήτρα ζητά να καταγράφεται κάθε προσπάθεια είσπραξης, με τις ημερομηνίες επικοινωνίας και τα αποτελέσματά τους, πριν από την πρόταση διαγραφής. Η διαγραφή δεν εφαρμόζεται σε οφειλές που προκύπτουν από απάτη ή από λάθος του πελάτη που έχει ήδη επιβεβαιωθεί, και η ρήτρα το αναφέρει ρητά ώστε να μην παρερμηνεύεται. Οι διαγραμμένες οφειλές παραμένουν στα αρχεία για τον έλεγχο της περιόδου, και δεν εξαφανίζονται από τον φάκελο του πελάτη. Η ρήτρα προβλέπει ότι κάθε διαγραφή εγκρίνεται γραπτά πριν από την καταχώρισή της στο Ledger.

excerpts.section: Group policy: Finance > SECTION 7  Billing, part 3
excerpts.text:
Invoice numbering is continuous, and no number may be skipped or reused, even when a draft is cancelled. The numbering sequence is held by the billing system and is checked each period by the finance team. Any gap in the sequence is investigated and recorded before the period is closed. The finance director signs the gap report before the period is closed, so that the explanation is on file.

Electronic invoices are stored in the approved archive for the period set in the retention schedule, and printed copies are kept only where the contract requires them. 4b43c6e48b3004bf9353211eec7e85c0.section: Group policy: Finance > SECTION 7  Billing, part 3
4b43c6e48b3004bf9353211eec7e85c0.text: Electronic invoices are stored in the approved archive for the period set in the retention schedule, and printed copies are kept only where the contract requires them. Access to the archive is limited to the billing and audit teams. Any copy taken outside the archive must be recorded and destroyed when it is no longer needed. Archive access is reviewed by the audit team at the end of each year.

4c34de4b668e2a86676a43d2e0d0c5d8.text: Billing corrections follow a fixed sequence that keeps the original record intact. The billing team identifies the error, confirms the correct amount with the contract, and prepares a credit note that refers to the original bill. The credit note is approved by a second person and recorded in Ledger with the reason for the correction. A new bill is issued where the correction changes the amount payable, and it carries the same reference as the original bill with a version number. The customer is informed of the correction in writing, using the approved template, and the explanation states the amount and the reason. Corrections that affect several customers are grouped into a single case and reviewed by the billing lead before they are released. The billing team does not delete an original bill, even when it was issued in error. The correction log is reviewed by the controller at the close of each period.

Η διαγραφή δεν εφαρμόζεται σε οφειλές που προκύπτουν από απάτη ή από λάθος του πελάτη που έχει ήδη επιβεβαιωθεί, και η ρήτρα το αναφέρει ρητά ώστε να μην παρερμηνεύεται. The numbering sequence is held by the billing system and is checked each period by the finance team. Any gap in the sequence is investigated and recorded before the period is closed. The finance director signs the gap report before the period is closed, so that the explanation is on file.

6d1c316bdc22d2d2b11512948891ed5d.text: Every member of staff who handles customer contact is bound by the same conduct standard, whether they work on the phone, in the chat or in writing. Customers who dispute an invoice receive a written answer within the period set in the contract, and the answer explains the basis of the charge. The clause requires that all disputed invoices are kept on file until the dispute is closed and the audit has been completed.

88fff8f777db39bc636e280359e2bff5.section: Contract and clause library: Finance > SECTION 6  Billing
88fff8f777db39bc636e280359e2bff5.text: The billing clause sets out when consumer bills are produced and how their content is controlled. Consumer bills for TV packages are issued on day 25 of each month. Bills are generated in Ledger from the active contract records, and the billing team reviews a sample before the run is released. Any change to the price of a package must be included in the template with its effective date, so that the bill reflects the agreed price. Customers receive a clear breakdown of the charges, including taxes and any one off items, in a format that complies with the consumer protection rules. Bills that are reissued for a correction carry the original reference and a short explanation of the change. The clause forbids the use of estimated figures unless the customer has agreed to that in writing. The billing lead signs off each run and keeps the record for audit purposes.

Documents in the library carry a version number and an effective date, so that users can see which text applies to a contract signed on a given day. Old versions are kept for reference but are marked clearly, and no one should use an old version for a new customer without checking with the legal team first. Questions about access go to the library administrator, who answers them within the same working day.

ab3846213be0257b385eaafd903238a7.text: Supplier payments are governed by a separate clause, because the company is the buyer in these transactions and not the seller. Payment runs are approved in batches, and each batch is reconciled to the bank statement before the next run starts.

ddc2011e8cb1d34568f97dea97d3a654.text: The playbook applies to every customer interaction and sets the baseline for behaviour, data protection and the handling of sensitive matters. The playbook is reviewed each period, and changes are published before they take effect.

de789c5a64bb2f062851976edf5692b8.text: Approvals given in person or by phone are not valid unless they are written up and signed within the same working day. The finance team checks the approval log at the close of each period, and any approval that cannot be matched to a written record is escalated to the finance director. Approvers are asked to check the delegation table before signing, so that no decision is taken outside their authority.

Before the run is released, the billing team checks the totals against the control report and investigates any difference. A sample of bills is reviewed line by line against the contract terms, so that errors in the price or the discount are found before the customer sees them. Any bill that fails the check is held, corrected and then released in the next run. The billing lead signs the control report, and the signed copy is archived with the run. Changes to the billing rules are made only through the approved change process, and they are tested on a sample before they are applied to all customers. Records of each run are kept for the period set in the retention schedule, so that any question can be answered later.

The line manager confirms receipt of the notice in writing and starts the handover plan on the same day. The handover covers open tasks, access to systems and the transfer of any customer or supplier relationships. HR confirms the final date, the outstanding leave and the return of company property, and it explains the final payment process. Exit interviews are offered to every leaver and are used to improve how the company manages its people. Information from exit interviews is reported in aggregate, so that individual comments cannot be identified. Employees who leave are told how to request a reference, and the process is explained in writing.

822108ca2b1c52a4510e1aaef3d63234.text: Access to company systems is removed on the last working day, in the order set by the access procedure, so that no one keeps access after they have left. Leavers who have signed confidentiality agreements or restrictive covenants are reminded of their obligations in writing, and the legal team is consulted where a question arises. References are given only by HR, using the approved template, and only with the employee's consent where the law requires it. Rehire eligibility is recorded in the HR system, with the reason, so that later applications are handled consistently.

HR confirms the final date, the outstanding leave and the return of company property, and it explains the final payment process. Exit interviews are offered to every leaver and are used to improve how the company manages its people. Information from exit interviews is reported in aggregate, so that individual comments cannot be identified. Employees who leave are told how to request a reference, and the process is explained in writing.

excerpts.text: Incident response begins with detection, which may come from monitoring alarms, from the customer service desk or from a field engineer who notices a fault during another visit. The on-call engineer classifies the incident by severity soon after detection, and the classification decides who is alerted and in what order. A detected incident is opened in Compass at once, even when the cause is not yet known, so that the record starts at the true time. The engineer records the affected customers, the equipment involved and the first suspected cause, and avoids guessing when the evidence does not yet support a view. Each incident has a single owner who coordinates the work, and that owner changes only with a written handover. The owner keeps the incident record up to date until the incident is closed, so that anyone joining the work can see what has been tried.

excerpts.section: Operations manual: Network Operations > SECTION 2  Availability
excerpts.text:
Availability is measured continuously by the monitoring system, which records each outage with its start time and end time. The control team checks the outages of each shift against customer reports, to find events that the system did not capture automatically. Any outage that exceeds the expected duration opens an incident in Compass and is assigned to an engineer without delay.

Availability reports are produced each month and are checked by the quality lead before they are sent to management. Any difference between the monitoring data and the Compass records is explained in writing, and the explanation is kept with the report. A report is never changed after it has been issued, except to correct a clear recording error. Corrections are logged with the date, the author and the reason, so that the history of each report remains visible to the management team.

35b98c17aeeb7ae4e2bf41a7d6d2a2de.text: Field visits are the point where the network meets the customer, and the policy sets the standard for how technicians arrive, work and leave. Staff verify the identity of the caller before discussing any account, and they never reveal account details to a third party without a valid authority on file. Recording of calls is disclosed at the start of each call, and the recording is used only for quality, training and dispute purposes. Staff must not pressure customers into decisions, and they must not describe a product in a way that is misleading. Notes on the case must be factual, polite and free of personal opinions, because the customer may request a copy of the record. Any suspected breach of these rules is reported to the team leader immediately, so that the risk can be contained.

b8c8ee1d19b3b614c1da51919b434873.section: Operations manual: Network Operations > SECTION 6  Incident response, part 3
b8c8ee1d19b3b614c1da51919b434873.text: When service is restored, the incident owner writes a review that states what happened, what was done, how long customers were affected and what should change. The review is written in plain language and avoids naming individuals, so that the focus stays on the system rather than on people. Actions from the review are assigned to a named owner with a date for completion, and their status is checked at the regular operations meeting until each action is closed. Reviews are stored with the incident record and can be searched by equipment type, which helps the team spot repeated failures. Where a review finds that a monitoring alarm was missed, the monitoring configuration is corrected at once and the change is recorded. The team uses these reviews to decide which alarms need more attention during future planned work.

be8eb23e3e00443840f586b63de5b962.text: Every member of the sales team treats customers with honesty and respect, and never makes a claim about a product or a price that the advisor cannot support from the system. Advisors who are unsure of an answer say so, and they check the answer before they speak to the customer again. Pressure tactics, such as inventing a deadline, are a breach of this procedure.

ddc2011e8cb1d34568f97dea97d3a654.text: The playbook applies to every customer interaction and sets the baseline for behaviour, data protection and the handling of sensitive matters. Staff verify identity before discussing any account, use the approved greeting and never mock or argue with a customer. Information is shared only with the account holder or with a person named in the authority record. Recording a call, taking a note or copying a document must follow the rules in the data protection annex. Staff do not use personal messaging to contact customers, because those messages cannot be audited. Where a customer makes a threat or uses abusive language, the agent follows the safety procedure and informs the team leader. Staff never promise an outcome they cannot deliver, and they say so openly when a decision is not theirs to make. The playbook is reviewed each period, and changes are published before they take effect.

f2c21ba20c3df3b52cf0d9743f451823.section: Operations manual: Network Operations > SECTION 3  Incident response
f2c21ba20c3df3b52cf0d9743f451823.text: Incident response begins with detection, which may come from monitoring alarms, from the customer service desk or from a field engineer who notices a fault during another visit. The on-call engineer classifies the incident by severity soon after detection, and the classification decides who is alerted and in what order. A detected incident is opened in Compass at once, even when the cause is not yet known, so that the record starts at the true time. The engineer records the affected customers, the equipment involved and the first suspected cause, and avoids guessing when the evidence does not yet support a view. Each incident has a single owner who coordinates the work, and that owner changes only with a written handover. The owner keeps the incident record up to date until the incident is closed, so that anyone joining the work can see what has been tried.

excerpts.text: Holding is a service that the customer experiences directly, so the policy sets a clear limit on how long a customer can be kept in the queue before the team offers a change. excerpts.text: When a customer must wait, the agent explains the reason for the wait and offers a callback if the wait is expected to be long. 00920b712133a701732abd751de73410.text:

Customers often ask whether they can be called back instead of waiting, and the answer is yes when the queue is long. The handler offers the option, records a preferred time window and confirms the number to be used before ending the call. A callback should be made by the same handler wherever possible, because a new person asking the same questions is one of the main reasons customers complain. ad0be72e7ddbe21819c854347a5dc7f8.text:
This section describes how the Sindos warehouse runs its day to day operations and how the team keeps stock records accurate between formal reviews. Stock counts at the Sindos warehouse take place every 2 weeks. Each count is recorded in Dock by the shift lead, who compares physical quantities with the system balance before any adjustment is accepted. Differences above the agreed tolerance are investigated before the stock record changes, and the outcome is noted against the item code. Goods that arrive damaged go to a separate bay and do not count as available until a supervisor has inspected them. Every pallet is scanned at the dock door, so that the system knows the location of the stock from the moment it enters the building. Pickers work from the Dock task list only, and any manual change needs approval from the duty supervisor. The warehouse keeps a visible board with the next count date, the responsible lead and the zones that are closed for counting.

Questions about counting procedures go to the warehouse operations lead, who keeps the master copy of this section.

Records of contracts, billing and customer correspondence are kept for the period required by the law, and then they are deleted or anonymised. Retention periods must be applied by the system wherever possible, rather than by a manual clean up that depends on memory. Backups follow the same retention rules, and a restored backup must not reintroduce data that has already been deleted. The legal team reviews the schedule when a new product is launched or when the law changes. Requests to change the retention period for a category must be justified in writing and approved before they are applied.

Staff who find personal data kept beyond its period must report it to the data protection officer at once.

cc25adf309d30b9a36fb4589a859d1d2.section: Operations manual: Customer Care > SECTION 7  Callbacks and holding

de2a37b9851bfa39f46af68911677b8a.text: The tone of a holding message should be calm and clear, and it should explain that the customer is in a queue without giving an exact waiting time. When a customer asks how long they will wait, the agent gives a general indication and offers a callback in the same call. Customers who have been waiting for a long time are offered the callback without being asked, to keep the experience respectful. Agents do not place customers on hold during a conversation to look up information that they could have prepared earlier. The use of holding messages is checked by sampling calls at the end of each period.
